summary.text: Lee Nyquist is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 42, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was the Democratic nominee for New Hampshire State Senate District 9 in 2012, 2014 and 2016 and advanced from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary for the House seat.

paragraphs.text: Lee Nyquist ran for New Hampshire State Senate District 9 in 2012, losing to Andy Sanborn by 50.3% to 49.7%.
He ran again in 2014, when Sanborn won re-election, and in 2016, when he defeated Jeanne Dietsch in the Democratic primary and lost the general election to Sanborn.

According to Ballotpedia, his 2016 campaign website highlighted addressing the opioid crisis, raising the minimum wage, strengthening public education and ending questions about salary history in hiring.
